layers.note: Rebuilt on the release-3 towns and tracks. Longest reply time among the twelve model-month snapshots. Schematic links, not travel routes. Marked interchange locations are inferred, not proven harbours; the alternative adds proposed tracks and landings. Budgets update seat readouts, not political control. Uses a separate travel calculation from Imperial access. Two unresolved seats have no assigned times; see the methods for assumptions.
